findings: 448: Friday Evening paragraphs 1–6 are 30 November; Saturday Morning paragraphs 7–8 are 1 December, despite XML @when=30 November.

limitations: This is a section-date review, not a reply graph or transcription audit. It does not alter the canonical metadata audit or any correspondent review.
verdict: Preserve all XML constraints while using explicit body/header datelines for section proposals. 481 and 484 have supported two-day section splits; 448 has a supported Friday/Saturday split; 704 has a uniquely suggested but not fully corroborated 18 October date requiring manual review.
